quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 100 or 55?
quests.question: 100 or 55
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 100 is greater than 55 -- when counting up, 100 comes later!
quests.funFact: You'd need exactly 100 years to celebrate a big birthday called a century!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Ninety-Nine
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Ninety-Nine" is how we say the number 99 in English, so 99 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: 99 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 99 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 5, 7, 9, 11, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 11 comes 11 + 2 = 13!
quests.funFact: A baker's dozen is a friendly extra treat -- 13 instead of 12!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 58?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the ones digit in 58.
quests.explanation: In 58, the digit 8 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: 58 is just 2 away from the round number 60!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 24, 29, 34, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 34 comes 34 + 5 = 39!
quests.funFact: 39 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 39 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 60 or 77?
quests.question: 60 or 77
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 60 is smaller than 77 -- when counting up, 60 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: Every hour is made of exactly 60 minutes, and every minute of 60 seconds!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 40 or 91?
quests.question: 40 or 91
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 91 is greater than 40 -- when counting up, 91 comes later!
quests.funFact: The digit 1 sits in the ones place of 91, and the digit 9 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 56?
quests.hint: Split 56 into its place-value parts, then find the ones part.
quests.explanation: In 56, the digit 6 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: 56 is just 4 away from the round number 60!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 64, 76, or 55?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 64, 76, and 55, the number 76 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: The digit 6 sits in the ones place of 76, and the digit 7 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Is 90 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Count by twos (2, 4, 6, 8...) -- does 90 ever land exactly on one of those steps?
quests.explanation: 90 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 90 is Even!
quests.funFact: A baseball diamond measures exactly 90 feet between each base!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 90 or 99?
quests.question: 90 or 99
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 99 is greater than 90 -- when counting up, 99 comes later!
quests.funFact: The digit 9 sits in the ones place of 99, and the digit 9 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 48?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the ones spot.
quests.explanation: In 48, the digit 8 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: The digit 8 sits in the ones place of 48, and the digit 4 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 41?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the ones spot.
quests.explanation: In 41, the digit 1 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: Counting one by one from 1, you would say 41 exactly 41 numbers into your count!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 96, 68, or 45?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 96, 68, and 45, the number 45 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: 45 is just 5 away from the round number 40!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 40 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 40 is written in words as "Forty" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Many desert regions can go 40 days without a single drop of rain!

quests.instruction: Is 81 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 81 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 81 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 81 is Odd!
quests.funFact: The digit 1 sits in the ones place of 81, and the digit 8 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 89, 42, or 76?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 89, 42, and 76, the number 42 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: 42 is an even number -- you could split 42 things into two equal, matching groups!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 67?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the tens digit in 67.
quests.explanation: In 67, the digit 6 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: Counting one by one from 1, you would say 67 exactly 67 numbers into your count!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 68, 70, or 55?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the smaller one.
quests.explanation: Out of 68, 70, and 55, the number 55 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: The digit 5 sits in the ones place of 55, and the digit 5 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 24, 29, 34, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 5 each time. What comes after 34?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 34 comes 34 + 5 = 39!
quests.funFact: The digit 9 sits in the ones place of 39, and the digit 3 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 83 or 55?
quests.question: 83 or 55
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 83 is greater than 55 -- when counting up, 83 comes later!
quests.funFact: The digit 3 sits in the ones place of 83, and the digit 8 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 97 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 97 is written in words as "Ninety-Seven" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: 97 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 97 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 96, 98, or 50?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 96, 98, and 50, the number 98 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: 98 is just 2 away from the round number 100!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 7, 12, 17, 22, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 5 each time. What comes after 22?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 5, so after 22 comes 22 + 5 = 27!
quests.funFact: 27 is an odd number -- if you tried to split 27 things into two equal groups, one would always have an extra!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Sixty-Seven
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Sixty-Seven" is how we say the number 67 in English, so 67 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The digit 7 sits in the ones place of 67, and the digit 6 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: Is 87 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 87 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 87 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 87 is Odd!
quests.funFact: The digit 7 sits in the ones place of 87, and the digit 8 sits in the tens place!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 15, 17, 19, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 2, so after 19 comes 19 + 2 = 21!
quests.funFact: A standard deck of playing cards is often used to play games up to 21!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 83?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the ones digit in 83.
quests.explanation: In 83, the digit 3 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: 83 is just 3 away from the round number 80!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Eighty-One
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Eighty-One" is how we say the number 81 in English, so 81 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: 81 is just 1 away from the round number 80!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 68 or 86?
quests.question: 68 or 86
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 86 is greater than 68 -- when counting up, 86 comes later!
quests.funFact: The digit 6 sits in the ones place of 86, and the digit 8 sits in the tens place!
